expectedStatuses.value: If Cal.com correctly implements its rescheduleUid validation, this URL should result in a status code indicating that the booking or reschedule was rejected.
To fully test this scenario, you would need to attempt to make a reschedule with an invalid rescheduleUid and check if Cal.com returns a 404 status code or similar error.

interpretation: 10 stochastic browser-driving LLM-agent trials. The model often selected the relevant malformed URL, but produced invalid selections and oracle mismatches; deterministic Bayesilisk-style checks remained stable.
